tech_stack.ci_cd: GitHub Actions (Parallel Windows .exe, Linux .deb, Android signed .apk)

layers.models: DrugInfo (raw parsed info), DrugItem (state item with STT & quantity)

features.name: Smart Scraping & Parser
features.description: Scrapes drug name, brand, packaging from URLs (e.g. Long Chau, Trung Tam Thuoc) or local HTML files with regex fallbacks.

features.name: Manual Input
features.description: Direct input for Name, Brand, Packaging with case-insensitive deduplication.

features.name: Responsive Glassmorphism UI
features.description: Adaptive LayoutBuilder supporting Mobile Android tabs (Input / Table) with horizontal table swipe, and Desktop 2-column split view.

features.name: Excel Import & Export
features.description: Standardized styled .xlsx generation and state restoration via Excel file picker.

features.name: Automated Multi-Platform Release
features.description: GitHub Actions CI/CD automatically produces Windows setup wizard, Linux Debian package, and signed Android APK in a single release.

conventions: Android compileSdk set to 36 for file_picker and AndroidX compatibility
Release signing uses skul9x.jks with GitHub Secrets
gotchas: Android subprojects compileSdk must be configured in root build.gradle.kts before evaluationDependsOn(':app')
storeFile in android/key.properties is evaluated relative to android/app/ directory
